groupKey.description: Group key that identifies the type of group profile to update.

groupId.description: ID of the specific group profile to update.

set.description: Object of group profile properties to set.

ip.description: Set to 1 to use the request IP for geolocation updates.

strict.description: Set to 1 to return validation errors for invalid updates.

verbose.description: Set to 1 to include verbose validation messages in the response.

response.description: Mixpanel group ingestion success flag where 1 indicates success and 0 indicates failure.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

put.description: Updates multiple user profiles in Mixpanel.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

updates[].description: Array of Mixpanel user profile update objects. Each object must include $token, $distinct_id, and exactly one update operation such as $set or $union.

ip.description: Set to 1 to use the request IP for geolocation updates.

strict.description: Set to 1 to return validation errors for invalid updates.

verbose.description: Set to 1 to include verbose validation messages in the response.

response.description: Mixpanel ingestion success flag where 1 indicates success and 0 indicates failure.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
